gold_assessment.reasoning: Generated HPI-001 notes several days of not feeling well with a dry cough, and HPI-011 specifies onset about five days ago; this matches the 5‑day history of feeling unwell with cough/cold symptoms.

Gold specifies that the cough is mainly dry. Generated facts describe a dry cough but do not state it is ‘mainly’ dry; they add that it is worst in the morning, which is additional but not equivalent to ‘mainly dry’.
Gold: no chest pain and more SOB. Generated HPI-012 denies chest pain and HPI-005 notes some breathlessness; this captures both elements.

Gold notes feeling hot/cold and sweaty with no fevers. Generated HPI-006 only mentions feverish/sweaty episodes and ROS-001 mentions feverish sensations; the explicit absence of fever is not captured, and the hot/cold alternation is not mentioned.

Gold includes sore throat, blocked ears, and runny nose. Generated HPI-002 and HPI-003/ROS-005/ROS-007 cover runny nose and sore throat, but there is no mention of blocked ears, so the full combined fact is not fully captured.

Gold specifies myalgia and arthralgia as joint stiffness. Generated ROS-014 notes mild stiffness with movement but does not explicitly link this to myalgia or arthralgia; the muscle and joint pain diagnoses are missing.
Gold: diarrhea initially that has resolved. Generated HPI-009 and ROS-011 mention diarrhea on day 1 but do not state that it has resolved.
Gold states no unwell contacts and no nausea/vomiting. No generated fact addresses unwell contacts or nausea/vomiting.
Gold: obesity, type 2 diabetes, and hypertension. Generated PMH-001 and PMH-002 include diabetes and hypertension but omit obesity.
Gold: metformin, lisinopril, aspirin. Generated MED-001, MED-002, and MED-003 list these medications (with the qualifier that aspirin is occasional). The set of medications is captured.
Gold: NKDA. Generated ALLERGY-001 and ALLERGY-002 state no known medication allergies and none documented; this is equivalent.
Gold: lives with wife and works in factory/manufacturing. Generated SH-001 (lives with wife) and SH-002 (works in factory manufacturing steel parts) together cover this.

Gold: smoking socially and alcohol >9 units/week. Generated SH-003 quantifies alcohol as ~9 pints per week (more on weekends) and SH-004/SH-005 describe occasional smoking with vaporizer use to cut down. The social smoking pattern and alcohol quantity are not clearly matched to ‘socially’ and ‘>9 units/week’; they alter detail rather than directly restating it.
Gold impression: viral URTI with possible LRTI. Generated ASM-001 gives probable viral URI with flu-like symptoms but no mention of possible LRTI.

Gold: conservative management with rest, fluids, and regular paracetamol. Generated PLAN-001 (rest and fluids) and PLAN-002 (paracetamol for fever/discomfort) together capture this, though ‘regular’ dosing is not explicitly stated.

Gold: delayed prescription for amoxicillin to start in 24–48 hours if symptoms not improving. Generated PLAN-003 mentions amoxicillin 1 tablet TID but does not specify delayed start or the 24–48 hour conditional trigger.
Gold: review in one week if not better. Generated FU-002: follow up if not improved by next week (~7 days). This matches.

Gold: seek earlier review for worsening symptoms (chest pain, SOB, fevers). Generated FU-001: seek urgent care if fever worsens/persists, increased SOB, chest pain, confusion, or dehydration. This includes the specified triggers and adds more.
